title: Stratified interval-censored semi-parametric survival models
text: Semiparametric interval censored survival regression stratification cut package calculate Cox models interval censored data perform log-rank type test. especially designed mirror typical clinical trial survival analysis methods done right censored data. Therefore used sensitivity analysis presence interval censoring. package borrows heavily icenReg, specifically ic_sp() implementation. main change addition support stratified baseline hazards analytical derivatives. also implement profile likelihood variance estimation procedure regression coefficients. logrank test aims replace PROC ICLIFETEST test using Sun type weights imputed variance.

title: Sun's Log-Rank Test for Interval-Censored Data — ic_logrank
text: Performs Sun's (1996) non-parametric log-rank test comparing survival distributions across groups interval-censored data. test compares group-specific NPMLE survival curves without assuming proportional hazards. test statistic \(Q = U(0)' (0)^{-1} U(0)\), follows chi-squared distribution k-1 degrees freedom null hypothesis, k number groups. default test type "sas", uses Sun's test statistic combined variance estimated based Huang, Lee Yu (2008) procedure sampling exact observation times Turnbull intervals. Alternatively, "hly" type calculates test statistic variance using multiple imputation approach Huang, Lee Yu (2008) directly. Stratified tests constructed calculating \(U\) \(V\) matrices stratum separately summing stratum-specific matrices give global test statistic \(\sum\bar{U}' (\sum\hat{V})^{-1} \sum\bar{U}\). procedure described SAS documentation PROC ICLIFETEST.

title: Sun's Log-Rank Test for Interval-Censored Data — ic_logrank

Generalized Log-Rank Test Interval-Censored Failure Time Data via Multiple Imputation. Statistics Medicine 27:3217–3226. http://dx.doi.org/10.1002/sim.3211 SAS Institute Inc. (2026). SAS/STAT® 26.03 User's Guide: ICLIFETEST Procedure. https://documentation.sas.com/doc/en/statug/latest/statug_iclifetest_details01.htm Accessed 14 April 2026.

title: Profile Likelihood Covariance for Semi-Parametric Models — vcov.ic_sp2
text: covariance matrix calculated using profile likelihood approach. (Murphey Vand Der Vaart 2000). method involves perturbing regression parameters refitting model estimate curvature log-likelihood function, used compute covariance matrix. borrowing naming convention Stata stintcox manual https://www.stata.com/manuals/ststintcox.pdf. Type "oim_curvature" (Boruvka Cook 2015) uses curvature log-likelihood function determine perturbation size profile likelihood calculations, described Boruvka Cook (2014). typical large parameters used determine scale perturbations. Type "oim_fixed" (Zeng et al 2016) uses fixed perturbation size based fixed parameter sample size n. Type "opg_fixed" (Zeng et al 2017) uses fixed perturbation size based fixed parameter sample size n, uses outer product gradients instead observed information matrix covariance calculation. larged values fixed model fitting may fail converge.
